name: חיבור וחיסור שלושה שברים עם מכנים מספריים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express the following as a single fraction in it's lowest terms: \[\frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}+\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}-\frac{{CT:4}}{{CT:5}}. \]
[[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
When dealing with more than one fraction you can either focus on just two fractions at a time or, alternatively, you can find a suitable common factor for all the fractions and then peform all the arithmetic in one step. Using the latter technique in this example:
\[\frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}+\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}-\frac{{CT:4}}{{CT:5}} = \frac{{CT:6}}{{CT:7}}+\frac{{CT:8}}{{CT:7}}-\frac{{CT:9}}{{CT:7}} = {{CT:10}}. \]

on_true.feedback: Your answer is not in it's simplest form but is otherwise correct.
